description: Send the user's legal task to Pactum lawyers; a lawyer reviews it and contacts the user with a price. Call ONLY after the user asked to be contacted, gave their real name and phone or e-mail, and agreed that Pactum stores these details and may pass the request to a partner lawyer. Put the task in the user's own terms: situation, goal, key facts. Never invent contacts; never call it "to test". Returns the request number.

agent_name.description: Your assistant name, e.g. ChatGPT, Claude

budget.description: Budget, if the user named one

contact_name.description: Client name as the user gave it

deadline.description: When it is needed, e.g. "by 15 October"

preferred_language.description: Language for the lawyer to use

service_slug.description: Slug from search_services, if a specific service fits

task.description: What exactly the client needs: situation, goal, key facts

user_consent.description: true only if the user explicitly agreed to share these details with Pactum and its partner lawyer

name: request_quote
title: Request a price quote from a lawyer
